sourcesVerified.claim: The Foundation’s fetched transcript identifies January 17, 1925, and the American Society of Newspaper Editors. Its full text discusses business and the press, but also explicitly rejects wealth as life’s chief end. This is primary-text verification of the fuller wording, not endorsement of the shortened wording as exact.
